title: MetricsResult
description: Geometric metrics of the main building of one model version (v0.2 F-53; D-3D116-1..3). Geometric only: no cadastral, tax or normative values (v0.2 §16.5). BuildingInstallation bodies are excluded. Areas in m2, volumes in m3, local frame, not rounded.
$comment: Owner-approved member names and volumeStatus enum (D-3D116-1, D-3D116-2, D-18). The nine metric members are also the affectedMetrics names (D-3D116-4).

footprintAreaM2.description: Area of the union of the XY projections of the GroundSurface faces, holes kept.

roofPlanAreaM2.description: Area of the union of the XY projections of all RoofSurface faces, OVERHANG included; overlaps counted once.

roofSurfaceAreaM2.description: Sum of the 3D areas of all RoofSurface faces, OVERHANG included.

overhangRoofAreaM2.description: Sum of the 3D areas of RoofSurface faces tagged OVERHANG.

soffitAreaM2.description: Sum of the 3D areas of OuterCeilingSurface faces tagged OVERHANG (end caps excluded).

mainVolumeM3.description: Volume without overhangs; null when the volume or its split is not proven.

overhangVolumeM3.description: Volume of the overhangs (D-3D116-3); 0 without overhangs; null when the volume or its split is not proven.

geometricSolidVolumeM3.description: Total volume of the main building's solids, overhangs included; null when not proven.

volumeStatus.description: FINAL: VALID_SOLID / APPROVED and no volume-blocking error; PROVISIONAL: DRAFT_SOLID with a proven volume, never a final building volume; NOT_AVAILABLE: the total volume is not proven (D-3D116-2).

allOf.description: The split is given for both parts or for none (D-3D116-2 partial availability).
